styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio neutrals only: clean white #FFFFFF, light stone grey #E9E8E6 and soft blush beige #F2E4D6, with warm taupe #B98A60 and deep espresso #2B211C reserved for graphic cards and type; no location walls, no patterned prop scenery
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright neutral studio light, one large soft key from upper left at about 5600K, gentle wrap contact shadow, low contrast, matte material kept matte with no blown specular
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E4DED8 for vanity and flat-lay surfaces, seamless paper sweep everywhere else, no reflective tabletop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for every rendered slot; headline 26-40pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; all copy carried as placeholder slots, never as source sentences
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms, one continuous stroke, drawn in {accent_color} inside plain circles or rounded cards; no 3D icons, no filled glyph sets
styleLock.presentationRules: the pair always at one identical scale, either laid flat and uncreased or held by hands; rim taper and matte face finish never redrawn; on-body views restricted to clothed neck-down crops and hands; circular mask crops for all detail tiles
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium intimate-accessory e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless light stone grey #E9E8E6, soft blush beige #F2E4D6 and clean white #FFFFFF, with warm taupe #B98A60 and deep espresso #2B211C used only for graphic cards and type, plus exactly one product-matched accent {accent_color}; bright neutral studio light from one large soft key at upper left at about 5600K with gentle wrap contact shadows and no blown specular; matte light-stone counter #E4DED8 for flat and vanity surfaces, seamless paper sweep elsewhere; modern geometric sans-serif for every rendered slot, headline 26-40pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, all copy carried as placeholder slots; thin single-weight line pictograms in {accent_color} inside plain circles; the pair at identical scale throughout, rim taper and matte face finish never redrawn; hairline leader line with one small dot for callouts; dotted rule separators for spec rows; identical corner radius on every card; on-body views restricted to clothed neck-down crops and hands; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmarks, no watermarks, no QR codes.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 净白底上一枚贴片本体与掀盖小硬盒，盒面带字标与系列标签；002 细吊带裙模特对镜的后侧视角，右列大标题加两枚线描图标与主张文字；003 浅灰水泥面上左右两张圆角卡，左暖棕五列勾、右深咖五列叉，各配线描图形；004 模特上身赤裸仅以衣物遮挡、乳周可见贴片本体，左侧薄边主张与三枚嵌套圆环尺码对照（含英寸数与罩杯区间）；005 白底五只手臂自下方伸出、各托一枚由浅到深的贴片，顶部标题与五个色名；006 一双手在流水下冲洗贴片，底部五个步骤线描图标与英文字标；007 化妆台场景，大理石纹刷袋与散粉刷，模特敞开衬衫露出胸部与贴片；008 浅灰面上四组颈部以下女性线描躯干示意，四种器形与贴片实物分列，标注含英寸尺寸；009 五位不同肤色女性欢笑合影于白色砖墙前，左上字标与标语。品类判定依据：主体为贴身穿戴的可重复使用贴片，非外穿女装、非美妆着色彩妆、亦非护肤工具，故 L1 取「内衣家居服」、L2 取「女士内衣」，与源站类目（服饰配件）不符，以图为准改判。展示尺度处理：004/007/008 的裸露上身与躯干线描全部剔除，改为衣物覆盖的颈下裁切后侧视角、手部与梳妆台场景；002 前景裸背改为肩部以下裁切。已剥离：源品牌字标、系列名与标语、原图英文字标与全部原句文案、模特身份与面容、平台徽章与星级类社会证明、原平台店铺字样与二维码。已脱敏为占位符的数值：色号数量与色名、三档直径英寸数、罩杯适配区间、可重复使用次数与寿命、背胶与材质等级主张，一律改为 {callout_*}/{selling_point_*} 或空白参数行与空圈环，不回填任何真实数字。与库内既有「内衣家居服」条目（运动内衣、三角内裤、家居服套装等）在单品、器形与视觉体系上均不重叠。
